title: Does a Frontier Large Language Model Know What It Can Solve? A 100-Conjecture Calibration Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.28827v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How does confidence correlate with actual performance in large language models, when attacking open research-level math problems? We address this question by studying the performance of ChatGPT 5.6 Sol Ultra on a set of 100 open conjectures in geometric analysis. By construction, the model first selected open problems in geometric analysis that it assessed that it had at least a 50\% chance of proving or disproving, and then assigned a probability of success to each question. 13 questions were then excluded after an audit, and the model was asked to resolve the remaining 87 problems. translated_title: 前沿大语言模型知道自己能解决什么吗？一项基于100个猜想的校准研究
translated_abstract: 当大语言模型攻克开放的研究级数学问题时，其置信度与实际表现之间有何关联？我们通过研究ChatGPT 5.6 Sol Ultra在100个几何分析领域的开放猜想上的表现来探讨这一问题。在实验设计中，模型首先自行挑选它评估认为有至少50%概率能够证明或证伪的几何分析开放问题，然后为每个问题分配一个成功概率。经审核后剔除了13个问题，随后要求模型解决剩余的87个问题。模型平均声称的解决概率为0.617，而实际观测到的成功率为0.103（Brier分数为0.351，期望校准误差ECE为0.513），这表明模型在自我评估中存在系统性的过度自信。然而，这些评分仍然保留了排序信号（AUROC为0.714）。模型在概率数值上严重过度自信，但在……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 研究发现，前沿大语言模型对自行挑选的研究级数学开放猜想存在系统性过度自信——其自评成功率0.617与实际成功率0.103相差悬殊，但其置信度评分仍保留了一定的排序参考价值。
en_tdlr: A frontier LLM is systematically overconfident about which open research-level math conjectures it can solve—self-estimated success probability 0.617 versus an actual rate of 0.103—though its confidence scores still retain ranking signal (AUROC 0.714).
